equal_bird_weight_null.statistic: median of separately estimated bird-specific beta_H values

workflow_provenance.note: Full per-bird and leave-one-bird-out fits are preserved in the GitHub Actions artifact and job log; this committed summary records the inferential quantities used by the manuscript/status layer.

interpretation: The pooled negative local-heterogeneity coefficient retains its direction under every leave-one-bird-out deletion, and the equal-bird-weight observed median is far below the matched pseudo-used null. The state-portfolio mechanism result is therefore not driven by one high-weight bird, while individual responses remain heterogeneous.
boundary: This is a robustness audit of a post-hoc mechanism result, not independent replication.
Bird-specific two-predictor coefficients can be noisy with small event counts and are descriptive.
Seven of ten separately fitted birds have negative beta_H; do not claim universal individual-level support.
No geographic movement causation or emigration prevention is inferred.
